column2: A price or an amount — what something costs, or what is owed
Confirming you HAVE received a payment
Saying you have NOT received a payment. Use your normal way of saying 'not' — this exact shape has already broken two engines
Asking someone to send money, with the amount
A message containing a phone number
A message containing an account number or a code (like an OTP)
Arranging a meeting — with a day and a time
Telling someone a plan has changed to a different day or time
Saying you are running late, with how long
Telling someone NOT to do something, or a warning
Asking someone to bring or collect something
A greeting — how you would really open a message
A question to a friend or family member
A message that MIXES English with your language, if that is how you normally write. Leave blank if that is not natural for you
